why: Separate actual hardware desktop performance from software Canvas diagnostics and verify maximum building/custom resident activation after the frame binding correction.

backend.deviceString: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Pro, Version 26.5.2 (Build 25F84))

visualReview: All four final captures individually inspected. No missing world, obvious corrupt building/resident rendering or blocking HUD overlap observed in these samples. The deliberately dense stress fixture is not landscape design approval.
finding: Four 60-second phases completed, browser errors empty, independent source/native/checkpoint verifier passed. Hardware frame gaps are substantially lower than the retained SwiftShader run. No production night-renderer workaround was promoted.
limits: One Mata Atlantica seed-42 maximum-building fixture with twelve distinct v5/v6 resident recipes. Not the whole performance matrix.
Developer snapshot import and forced 16x are diagnostic setup, not public authoring or speed control verification.
Cache samples exclude total native/process/GPU memory and do not prove a long-term memory plateau.
Browser animation frame timing is not external physical-display instrumentation.
No source-equivalent headless rerun after the body-preparation fix; old software measurement is historical evidence, not a controlled backend-only A/B.
